---
title: "Peter vis"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Define the Nodes
nodes <- tribble(
  ~node_id,      ~time_layer, ~type,   ~label,                      ~x,  ~y,
  "mac_start_1", 1990,        "Macro", "Analog Market Norms",       0,   10,
  "mic_start_1", 1990,        "Micro", "Traditional Retailer",      0,   0,
  "mic_end_1",   1990,        "Micro", "Launch Basic Website",      10,  0,
  "mac_end_1",   1990,        "Macro", "Early Web Infrastructure",  10,  10,
  "mac_start_2", 2000,        "Macro", "Early Web Infrastructure",  0,   10,
  "mic_start_2", 2000,        "Micro", "Brick-and-Click Firm",      0,   0,
  "mic_end_2",   2000,        "Micro", "Invest in Supply Chain",    10,  0,
  "mac_end_2",   2000,        "Macro", "Rise of Global E-commerce", 10,  10
)

# 2. Define the Edges
edges <- tribble(
  ~source,       ~target,       ~edge_type, 
  "mac_start_1", "mic_start_1", "Causal",
  "mic_start_1", "mic_end_1",   "Causal",
  "mic_end_1",   "mac_end_1",   "Causal",
  "mac_start_1", "mic_end_1",   "Causal",
  "mic_end_1",   "mic_start_2", "Temporal", # The dashed path between layers
  "mac_end_1",   "mac_start_2", "Temporal"
)

# 3. Join them to create a plottable dataframe
visualization_data <- edges |>
  left_join(nodes, by = join_by(source == node_id)) |>
  rename(source_x = x, source_y = y, source_z = time_layer) |>
  left_join(nodes, by = join_by(target == node_id)) |>
  rename(target_x = x, target_y = y, target_z = time_layer)
```

```{r}
# Load necessary tidyverse and visualization libraries
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)

# 1. Define the Nodes
nodes <- tribble(
  ~node_id,      ~time_layer, ~type,   ~label,                      ~x,  ~y,
  "mac_start_1", 1990,        "Macro", "Analog Market Norms",       0,   10,
  "mic_start_1", 1990,        "Micro", "Traditional Retailer",      0,   0,
  "mic_end_1",   1990,        "Micro", "Launch Basic Website",      10,  0,
  "mac_end_1",   1990,        "Macro", "Early Web Infrastructure",  10,  10,
  "mac_start_2", 2000,        "Macro", "Early Web Infrastructure",  0,   10,
  "mic_start_2", 2000,        "Micro", "Brick-and-Click Firm",      0,   0,
  "mic_end_2",   2000,        "Micro", "Invest in Supply Chain",    10,  0,
  "mac_end_2",   2000,        "Macro", "Rise of Global E-commerce", 10,  10
)

# 2. Define the Edges
edges <- tribble(
  ~source,       ~target,       ~edge_type, 
  "mac_start_1", "mic_start_1", "Causal",
  "mic_start_1", "mic_end_1",   "Causal",
  "mic_end_1",   "mac_end_1",   "Causal",
  "mac_start_1", "mic_end_1",   "Causal",
  "mic_end_1",   "mic_start_2", "Temporal", 
  "mac_end_1",   "mac_start_2", "Temporal"
)

# 3. Reshape Edges for Plotly (Long Format)
# We add a unique edge_id, then pivot so each edge has a 'source' row and 'target' row.
edges_long <- edges |>
  mutate(edge_id = row_number()) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(source, target), 
    names_to = "node_role", 
    values_to = "node_id"
  ) |>
  # Join back to our nodes to fetch the X, Y, Z coordinates for each point
  left_join(nodes, by = "node_id")

# 4. Render the 3D Visualization
fig <- plot_ly() |>
  
  # Layer A: Causal edges (Solid lines within the same time layer)
  add_trace(
    data = edges_long |> filter(edge_type == "Causal"),
    x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~time_layer,
    split = ~edge_id,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(color = "#1f77b4", width = 5),
    name = "Causal Mechanism",
    showlegend = TRUE
  ) |>
  
  # Layer B: Temporal edges (Dashed lines connecting time layers)
  add_trace(
    data = edges_long |> filter(edge_type == "Temporal"),
    x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~time_layer,
    split = ~edge_id,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(color = "#ff7f0e", width = 5, dash = "dash"),
    name = "Temporal Evolution",
    showlegend = TRUE
  ) |>
  
  # Layer C: The Nodes (Points marking the actors and states)
  add_trace(
    data = nodes,
    x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~time_layer,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "markers+text",
    marker = list(size = 6, color = "#2ca02c", symbol = "circle"),
    text = ~label,
    textposition = "top center",
    textfont = list(size = 10, color = "#333"),
    name = "Entities",
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  
  # 5. Clean up the aesthetic environment
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "Macro-Micro-Macro Transitions over Time",
      y = 0.95
    ),
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "Micro/Macro Focus", showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE),
      yaxis = list(title = "Progression", showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE),
      zaxis = list(title = "Time Layer (Years)", tickvals = c(1990, 2000)),
      camera = list(
        eye = list(x = -1.5, y = -1.5, z = 1.2) # Sets a comfortable isometric viewing angle
      )
    ),
    # Remove duplicate legend entries caused by the split parameter
    showlegend = FALSE 
  )

# Display the interactive plot
fig
```
